fee_notes: Operating Fee (royalty) is 6% of Gross Sales with $500/month minimum; no minimum during extension fee periods. National Marketing Fee is 3% (can increase to 5% with 60 days notice; if no Regional Marketing Fund, franchisee must spend 2% locally or NMF increases to 5%). Regional Marketing Fee up to 2% if applicable. Software and Security Fee $290-$350/month. Technology Fee $200/month.
raw_excerpt: Operating Fee 6% of Gross Sales *Subject to a monthly minimum fee of $500 ... National Marketing Fee 3% of monthly Gross Sales ... Technology Fee Reasonable monthly fee; currently $200 per month.
